input.plan:
# Public GitHub repo cleanup

GitHub current tree (`origin/main` of [AminMortezaie/relocation-jobs](https://github.com/AminMortezaie/relocation-jobs)) still ships product catalog dumps and internal leftovers that production no longer reads. Catalog lives in Postgres. Cleanup is **HEAD-only** (old commits keep the JSON; no force-push). **Keep** `docs/backlog.md` and all proposal/incident docs for the future tech blog.

## What GitHub currently exposes (verified on `origin/main`)

- [`companies/germany_companies.json`](companies/germany_companies.json) — 168KB, 88 companies, **230 jobs**, source `relocate.me`, last fetched 2026-06-02
- [`companies/netherlands_companies.json`](companies/netherlands_companies.json) — 83KB, 48 companies, 105 jobs
- [`companies/portugal_companies.json`](companies/portugal_companies.json) — 18KB
- [`companies/uk_companies.json`](companies/uk_companies.json) — 2KB test fixture (`Acme Backend Ltd`)
- [`kuchup.com-audit/`](kuchup.com-audit/) — 71 files, 1.4MB: raw HTML crawls, screenshots, PageSpeed JSON, local paths under `/Users/amin/...`
- [`tmp_inject_fetch.py`](tmp_inject_fetch.py) — one-off debug script that mutates in-process fetch state; zero callers

Runtime does **not** read `companies/*.json`. [`relocation_jobs/build_companies.py`](relocation_jobs/build_companies.py) already loads/saves via Postgres (`load_country_catalog_db` / `sync_country_catalog_db`). Ireland never had a JSON file.

Local working tree already has the four JSON files deleted (unstaged/staged `D`); they are still on GitHub until this lands.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  subgraph before [GitHub HEAD today]
    json["companies/*.json"]
    audit["kuchup.com-audit/"]
    tmp["tmp_inject_fetch.py"]
    archive["docs/archive/"]
  end
  subgraph runtime [What production uses]
    pg["Postgres catalog"]
    scrape["fetch + scrape"]
    panel["panel / homepage"]
  end
  json -.->|"not read"| pg
  scrape --> pg
  pg --> panel
```

## Delete from the tree

**Data dumps**

- `companies/` (all four JSON files)
- `kuchup.com-audit/` (entire folder)
- `tmp_inject_fetch.py`

**Stale unused scripts/docs**

- [`scripts/migrate_sqlite_to_neon.py`](scripts/migrate_sqlite_to_neon.py) — completed SQLite→Neon one-shot; Neon itself was replaced by AWS EC2 Postgres
- [`scripts/refetch_smartrecruiters_descriptions.py`](scripts/refetch_smartrecruiters_descriptions.py) — wrapper around `fix_job_descriptions.py`; no remaining references
- [`docs/archive/`](docs/archive/) — `refactor-handoff.md`, `v2-bugfix-handoff.md`, `v2-coding-verdict.md` (v1/v2 agent handoffs). Drop the empty `docs/archive/` directory after.

**Do not delete** (still used or explicitly kept)

- `docs/backlog.md`, all `docs/reference/*-proposal.md` and incident postmortems, ops docs
- [`scripts/build_companies.py`](scripts/build_companies.py) — still the catalog discovery CLI; writes Postgres
- One-shot **DB** backfills that can still be re-run: `exclude_stray_board_jobs.py`, `mark_wrong_location_jobs.py`, `fix_job_descriptions.py`
- [`relocation_jobs/static/public.html`](relocation_jobs/static/public.html) — fallback if the Next export is missing ([`web/server.py`](relocation_jobs/web/server.py) `public_home_page`)
- `tests/fixtures/` — scraper tests
- `design.md`, `.cursor/rules/`, deploy scripts

## Code leftovers tied to the JSON archive (safe)

[`country_archive_filename()`](relocation_jobs/core/paths.py) is still used as a **string label** in fetch-run metadata and API JSON (`file: "uk_companies.json"`). Keep the helper so fetch_runs / tests stay stable; stop pretending it is a git path.

In [`relocation_jobs/core/paths.py`](relocation_jobs/core/paths.py):

- Delete unused `COMPANIES_DIR`
- Collapse `COUNTRY_ARCHIVE_FILENAMES` into `return f"{key}_companies.json"` (Ireland already uses this fallback)
- Keep `country_archive_filename()`; drop the “git archive” comment

In [`relocation_jobs/build_companies.py`](relocation_jobs/build_companies.py): replace `COUNTRY_CLI_ALIASES` JSON-filename map (`"nl" → "netherlands_companies.json"`) with a country-key map (`"nl" → "netherlands"`). Update the module docstring (it still talks about `{country}_companies.json`).

Remove unused imports of `COUNTRY_ARCHIVE_FILENAMES` from [`companies/service.py`](relocation_jobs/companies/service.py) and [`admin/service.py`](relocation_jobs/admin/service.py) (imported, never referenced).

## Docs / gitignore so it does not come back

- [`.gitignore`](.gitignore): add `companies/` and `kuchup.com-audit/`
- [`README.md`](README.md) and [`docs/reference/architecture.md`](docs/reference/architecture.md): remove the `companies/*.json | Git archive only` data-store row
- [`docs/reference/schemas.md`](docs/reference/schemas.md): drop the git-archive filename sentence
- [`docs/README.md`](docs/README.md): remove `archive/` from the index
- [`docs/contributing.md`](docs/contributing.md): drop the link to `archive/v2-coding-verdict.md` (keep the open item about SQL in `users/history.py`)
- [`.cursor/rules/v2-coding.mdc`](.cursor/rules/v2-coding.mdc): drop the “violations backlog” pointer to the archive file
- [`docs/operations/aws-postgres.md`](docs/operations/aws-postgres.md): remove `migrate_sqlite_to_neon.py` mentions

## Tests

Run after the edits:

```bash
pytest tests/core/test_custom_countries.py tests/web/test_fetch_api.py -o addopts=
```

[`test_country_archive_filename_for_custom_country`](tests/core/test_custom_countries.py) still expects `uk_companies.json` / `ireland_companies.json` strings — those assertions stay valid.

## Out of scope

- Git history rewrite / force-push
- Removing proposal, backlog, or incident docs
- Changing fetch-run `file` API fields
- Committing (only if you ask)
